vopros: Are there private schools in West Los Angeles that offer language immersion from preschool through elementary?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. The clearest West Los Angeles options I found are:

- **Saint Sebastian School — Sawtelle/West LA**  
  **Spanish–English dual-language immersion** from **preschool through elementary** (and continuing into middle school). Its preschool program is described as full Spanish immersion, with a 50/50 Spanish-English model beginning in TK and continuing upward. It is a private Catholic school at **1430 Federal Ave., Los Angeles, CA 90025**.  
  Website: [saintsebastianschool.com](https://saintsebastianschool.com/)

- **Intiwasi School — Pico-Robertson**  
  A private **Spanish immersion** school offering **preschool and elementary** programming, with a Spanish-English, inquiry-based curriculum. It is at **9017 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90035**.  
  Website: [intiwasischool.com](https://www.intiwasischool.com/)

A nearby French option worth checking is:

- **Lycée Français de Los Angeles — Century City campus**  
  Offers a bilingual French-English preschool program at its Century City location (**10361 W. Pico Blvd.**). Confirm directly with the school which elementary grades are currently offered at that campus versus another Lycée campus.

When contacting them, ask specifically about (1) the percentage of the day taught in the target language at each grade, (2) whether children with no prior exposure can enter after preschool, and (3) current grade availability and admissions timing.
